history.summary: New launch, 760-770 Dunearn Rd D11, 380 units 99LH, Frasers/CSC Land/Sekisui, TOP Dec-2030, bookings 25-Jul-2026. Priced $2,799-3,030 psf. Evaluated for investment (5-7yr hold) at two budgets: $1.6m (527sf 2BR, mid/high floor, ~$3,036 psf) and $2.597m (872sf 3BR, lowest floor, $2,978 psf). Both AVOID for investment; the 3BR is the less-bad of the two. Core problem: CCR realized only +2.1%/yr over 10yr (+3.4% over 5yr) vs OCR +5.6%/+7.9%, break-even needs +2.3-2.4%/yr to sell at TOP, and gross yield is ~2.85% on both. The closest analogue (Fourth Avenue Residences, D10 99LH, Sixth Ave MRT) returned +1.4%/yr from 2021-2026 launch prices through the strongest bull market on record.
history.rating_rationale: MMR 179 (2BR) / 191 (3BR) out of 1000 - both deep below the 450 threshold. Age-adjusted (per the piecewise 0-10yr ~3%/yr PSF decay), the tightest comp - Fourth Avenue Residences, D10 99LH, same Sixth Ave MRT, $2,516 psf at age 3 - implies a fair new-build equivalent of ~$2,749 psf. On that basis the LOW-FLOOR 527sf 2BR at $2,799 is fairly priced (+1.8%), but the $1.6m mid/high-floor 527sf at $3,036 is +10.4% and the $2.597m 3BR at $2,978 is +8.3%. The raw 34-39% gap vs the D10/D11 leasehold resale pool overstates it - that pool is much older stock and must not be compared directly. TOP Dec-2030 means zero rent for 4.4yrs and no possible exit before 2031, turning a '5-7yr hold' into a 7-9yr capital lock-up. D11 is 87% freehold with only ~64 LH resales/yr - thin exit for an outlier product. At $1.6m the buyer lands in a pricing dead zone: too much for the entry 527sf 2BR (paying an ~8.5% floor premium on the project's weakest product, in the 46%-of-stock 2BR band, in the 10-storey blocks set 15m off an arterial road) and ~$120k short of the 614sf 2BR Premium. The $2.597m 3BR is exactly the lowest floor of a 20-unit scarce type, also in the road-facing Luxury blocks. Genuine bull points - land at $1,410 psf ppr vs the adjacent parcel's $1,625 (+11% re-rating headroom when site 2 launches 2H2027 at a projected $3,150-3,300), first-mover in Turf City, CRL Turf City MRT ~2032, Sixth Ave MRT 4min - are real but are a one-time step-up, not a return engine, and the developer's own public guidance ('happy with 70% take-up') signals a soft CCR launch market.

history.summary: Dunearn House — 380-unit 99-yr LH (from Sep 2025) new launch at 760-770 Dunearn Rd, D11 (first Bukit Timah Turf City GLS plot; Frasers/CSC Land/Sekisui JV; booking 25 Jul 2026, TOP Dec 2030). Indicative: 2BR/2BR+S 527-678sf from $1.475M ($2,799 psf); 3BR from $2.597M; 4BR from $3.588M. Evaluated for a 4-7yr resale-profit mandate (SC first-timer, ceiling $2.59M, prefer <$2.2M): only the 2BR fits.
history.rating_rationale: Avoid at indicative pricing for THIS mandate (4-7yr resale exit): entry $2,799-3,100 psf is 12-20% above the nearest completed 99LH comp (Fourth Avenue Residences 2BR resale median $2,504 psf, URA 2025-26 n=13) and in line with completed FREEHOLD product on Dunearn Rd (Pullman sub-sales $2,785-3,387); D10 2BR-band new-sale-over-resale premium runs ~38%. Region: D11/CCR — backtested worst forward region (+1.9%/yr realized vs OCR +3.7). Yield base case ~3.0% (large 2BR) to ~3.6% (small 2BR) vs 3.5% target, with NO income until TOP ~Dec 2030 and post-TOP exit landing at the back of (or beyond) the 4-7yr window. Manual --score sanity: 159-224/1000 (bull-case 4% rate: 180) vs the FAR resale benchmark at 384 on identical assumptions — the completed comp next door dominates. Bull case (land basis $1,410 psf ppr vs adjacent plot $1,625, analyst $3,150-3,300 psf umbrella 2H2027; Turf City masterplan/CRL) is real but analyst-inference, and buys exposure to a single-precinct transformation bet. If buying anyway (own-stay utility, umbrella conviction): small/mid 2BR only, mid-high floor, rear/side stack off Dunearn Rd — and re-judge if booking-day pricing lands materially below indicative.
red_flags: New-launch premium: $2,799-3,100 psf vs Fourth Avenue Residences 2BR resale $2,504 psf median (completed 99LH comp at Sixth Ave MRT)
CCR/D11 — backtested worst forward-return region (+1.9%/yr realized)
Gross yield base case ~3.0-3.3% project-average, below the 3.5% fallback target; zero income until TOP ~Dec 2030
TOP 31 Dec 2030 pushes realistic post-TOP exit to year ~4.5-7+, back edge of the 4-7yr mandate
Pre-launch: zero transactions, pricing indicative; per-stack facings/2BR locations unverified (front-blocks-only claim was refuted)
Adjacent 2nd GLS plot (Wing Tai-Metro) = 1.5yr of construction next door + future competing supply at resale
catalysts: Land basis $1,410 psf ppr vs adjacent plot $1,625 (+15.2%) — analyst-expected $3,150-3,300 psf launch next door ~2H2027 acts as a price umbrella
First mover in the Bukit Timah Turf City masterplan; site elevated over GCB land, selected stacks unblocked
Turf City CRL station in the pipeline (timing vs 2030-33 exit window unverified)
46% 2BR mix with no shoebox/1BR segment; 176-unit 2BR cohort = deepest in-project resale pool
Small 2BR (527sf, $1.475M) yields ~3.6% and sits in the most liquid quantum band
